title: Liquidation Acquisition Intelligence Pipeline — Input
description: Configure Liquidation exhaustive/targeted discovery, active auction extraction, resilient recovery, optional completed-history capture, eBay comp enrichment, webhook delivery, dedupe behavior, and governed exports.

sourceName.title: Source Name
sourceName.description: Logical source label for this run. Useful for auditability and downstream lineage.

runLabel.title: Run Label
runLabel.description: Optional operator label for this run, such as 'phones-test-run' or 'nightly-auction-scan'.

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Optional Liquidation.com auction search/detail URLs. In EXHAUSTIVE mode these are additive to governed active-auction discovery.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Optional Liquidation.com keyword searches using the public auction search surface.

discoveryMode.title: Discovery Mode
discoveryMode.description: EXHAUSTIVE crawls the active Liquidation.com auction catalog and discovered category/seller/filter partitions; TARGETED requires startUrls or keywords.

includeSellerPartitions.title: Include Seller Partitions
includeSellerPartitions.description: Traverse seller-filtered Liquidation.com search partitions discovered from active search pages for coverage reconciliation.

includeCategoryPartitions.title: Include Category/State Partitions
includeCategoryPartitions.description: Traverse category/filter Liquidation.com search partitions discovered from the live search facets.

includeCompleted.title: Include Completed Listings
includeCompleted.description: Also traverse governed closed-auction search surfaces when supported. Disabled by default for acquisition operations.

includeManifestItems.title: Ingest Manifest Line Items
includeManifestItems.description: Advanced. When on, every manifested lot also emits one manifest_item record per manifest line (SKU/UPC/quantity/retail) into the Dataset. Keep OFF for the intake integration: the intake treats every Dataset item as a lot, so manifest lines would be ingested as fake listings. Manifest URLs are kept in each lot's attributes either way.

noBidPricePolicy.title: No-bid price policy
noBidPricePolicy.description: For standard auctions with zero bids, use the site's published opening/minimum bid as current_price and mark attributes.price_type as starting_bid. Legacy NULL inputs are accepted but cannot clear a published price.

recordPages.title: Record sample pages
recordPages.description: Debug aid. Saves the HTML of the first 3 lot pages, 2 search pages and 1 manifest page to the run's key-value store as FIXTURE_html_detail_N / FIXTURE_html_index_N / FIXTURE_html_manifest_1, plus FIXTURE_urls. HTML only, no keys. Use for canaries and real test fixtures.

maxPages.title: Max Pagination Depth
maxPages.description: Maximum pagination depth per discovery partition. Use 0 for unlimited. EXHAUSTIVE production default is unlimited.

maxDiscoveryRequests.title: Max Discovery Requests
maxDiscoveryRequests.description: Optional hard cap for index/discovery requests. Use 0 for unlimited. Any truncation in EXHAUSTIVE mode makes the run incomplete.

maxDetailRequests.title: Max Detail Requests
maxDetailRequests.description: Optional hard cap for lot-detail requests. Use 0 for unlimited. Any truncation in EXHAUSTIVE mode makes the run incomplete and checkpoint-resumable.

maxRuntimeMinutes.title: Max Runtime Minutes
maxRuntimeMinutes.description: Optional source runtime ceiling. Use 0 for no actor-level ceiling; interrupted exhaustive runs remain checkpoint-resumable.

maxItemsPerRun.title: Max Items per Run
maxItemsPerRun.description: Legacy accepted-record safety cap. Use 0 for unlimited. A non-zero cap that truncates an EXHAUSTIVE run prevents PASS and leaves checkpointed work for resume.

maxConcurrency.title: Max Concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Maximum concurrent CheerioCrawler requests. Keep conservative for source safety.

maxRequestRetries.title: Max Request Retries
maxRequestRetries.description: How many times to retry a failed page request before giving up.

recoveryPersistInterval.title: Recovery Persist Interval
recoveryPersistInterval.description: Persist Liquidation discovery/checkpoint/reconciliation state after this many state mutations.

circuitBreaker403Threshold.title: 403 Circuit Breaker Threshold
circuitBreaker403Threshold.description: Open the Liquidation source circuit after this many consecutive HTTP 403 responses.

circuitBreaker5xxThreshold.title: 5xx Circuit Breaker Threshold
circuitBreaker5xxThreshold.description: Open the source circuit after this many consecutive upstream 5xx responses.

circuitBreaker429Threshold.title: 429 Circuit Breaker Threshold
circuitBreaker429Threshold.description: Open the source circuit after this many rate-limit events in one run.

proxyEnabled.title: Enable Proxy
proxyEnabled.description: Use an Apify proxy when explicitly enabled. Direct HTTP is the default, matching the certified PropertyRoom transport policy.

proxyFallbackToDirect.title: Allow Explicit Proxy Fallback to Direct
proxyFallbackToDirect.description: If proxy setup fails, allow direct transport only when explicitly enabled. Default is fail-closed.

singleWriterLeaseEnabled.title: Single-Writer State Lease
singleWriterLeaseEnabled.description: Prevent concurrent exhaustive Liquidation runs from mutating the same persistent recovery/dedupe state.

runLeaseTtlMinutes.title: Run Lease TTL (minutes)
runLeaseTtlMinutes.description: Expiration window for the Liquidation single-writer KV lease. Stale leases may be reclaimed after this interval.

completedEvidenceRetainEntries.title: Completed Recovery Evidence Retention
completedEvidenceRetainEntries.description: Number of completed discovery/disposition entries retained in compacted recovery state after a successful run. Final reconciliation and completion manifest remain preserved separately.

dedupePersistInterval.title: Dedupe Persist Interval
dedupePersistInterval.description: How many processed records to accumulate before persisting dedupe state.

enableFingerprintRefresh.title: Enable Fingerprint Refresh
enableFingerprintRefresh.description: Reprocess a listing if its content fingerprint changes across runs.

enableStaleRefresh.title: Enable Stale Refresh
enableStaleRefresh.description: Reprocess a listing after it becomes stale, even if unchanged.

staleAfterMinutes.title: Stale Refresh Threshold (minutes)
staleAfterMinutes.description: Minutes after which an unchanged listing becomes eligible for refresh.

debug.title: Debug Mode
debug.description: Enable verbose logging and extraction diagnostics.

webhookUrl.title: Webhook URL
webhookUrl.description: HTTP(S) endpoint to POST normalized records to.

webhookAuthToken.title: Webhook Auth Token
webhookAuthToken.description: Bearer token used for webhook authorization.

webhookBatchSize.title: Webhook Batch Size
webhookBatchSize.description: Number of records per webhook POST.

webhookMaxRetries.title: Webhook Max Retries
webhookMaxRetries.description: Maximum retries on retryable webhook failures.

webhookReplayDeadLetterOnStart.title: Replay Dead Letter on Start
webhookReplayDeadLetterOnStart.description: Attempt replay of dead-letter webhook batches at the start of a run.

webhookDeliveryRequired.title: Require Webhook Delivery
webhookDeliveryRequired.description: Fail the Actor run if any webhook batch cannot be delivered after configured retries.

ebayClientId.title: eBay Client ID
ebayClientId.description: eBay Developer Client ID / App ID.

ebayClientSecret.title: eBay Client Secret
ebayClientSecret.description: OAuth Client Secret for eBay token exchange.

ebayEnvironment.title: eBay Environment
ebayEnvironment.description: Use production for live data or sandbox for testing.

ebayCategoryIds.title: eBay Category IDs
ebayCategoryIds.description: Category IDs for eBay listing retrieval.

ebayMaxResults.title: eBay Max Results per Query
ebayMaxResults.description: Maximum total listings per eBay query.

ebayIncludeSoldComps.title: Include eBay Sold Comps
ebayIncludeSoldComps.description: Also fetch completed/sold listings from eBay as comparables.

csvExportEnabled.title: Enable CSV Export
csvExportEnabled.description: Export normalized records to CSV after completion.

csvExportProfile.title: CSV Export Profile
csvExportProfile.description: Column profile to use for CSV export.

csvOutputDir.title: CSV Output Directory
csvOutputDir.description: Directory path for exported CSV files.

csvFileName.title: CSV File Name
csvFileName.description: Name of the exported CSV file.

googleSheetId.title: Google Sheet ID
googleSheetId.description: Spreadsheet ID from the Google Sheets URL.

googleSheetName.title: Google Sheet Tab Name
googleSheetName.description: Name of the sheet/tab to write data to.

googleSheetsExportProfile.title: Google Sheets Export Profile
googleSheetsExportProfile.description: Column profile to use for Google Sheets export.

googleServiceAccountKey.title: Google Service Account Key
googleServiceAccountKey.description: Service account JSON string or file path.

sqlExportEnabled.title: Enable SQL Export
sqlExportEnabled.description: Generate a SQL ingest file after the crawl completes.

sqlExportProfile.title: SQL Export Profile
sqlExportProfile.description: Logical SQL export profile for batch generation.

sqlWrapInTransaction.title: Wrap SQL Export in Transaction
sqlWrapInTransaction.description: Wrap generated SQL statements in BEGIN/COMMIT.

sqlOutputDir.title: SQL Output Directory
sqlOutputDir.description: Directory path for SQL export files.

sqlFileName.title: SQL File Name
sqlFileName.description: Name of the SQL output file.

recheckLots.title: Recheck Lots
recheckLots.description: Open lot URLs or auction IDs to fetch again, bypassing unchanged-record dedupe. Filled rechecks replace normal search for this run; ended lots are skipped unless includeCompleted is true.
